scope: Pinned SMB physical sensor head and lidar dependencies, plus explicit native Fortress profile conversion. No ROS1/ROS2 simulation equivalence claim.

smb_simulator.acquisition: Selected files extracted byte-for-byte from the previously downloaded archive after verifying its SHA-256.
smb_simulator.license: smb_description/package.xml declares MIT; the retained archive has no repository-wide LICENSE. Its separate smb_path_tracker license does not replace model ownership.

lidar_simulator.selection: Same already pinned dependency as RMF; declared by fixed GBPlanner packages_https.rosinstall. SMB README spells pseudo_bpearl, but the selected branch follows the GBPlanner dependency lock, not a new HEAD. No historical same-date claim.
lidar_simulator.acquisition: Two macros downloaded from raw.githubusercontent.com at the exact commit; plugin and three VLP meshes from public GitHub Git blob API after raw connections timed out. Existing same-commit license, package declaration and Ouster mesh reused. Every lidar file verified against its pinned Git tree blob SHA-1; SHA-256 also recorded.
lidar_simulator.license: Unmodified upstream LICENSE retained. It is headed BSD 2-Clause but contains the non-endorsement condition too; preserve the actual license text without relabeling it. lidar_description/package.xml declares BSD.

meshes/VLP-16/VLP-16_base_1.dae.change: Replace only literal angle brackets in the id/name node labels <STL_BINARY>; no mesh coordinates, indices, materials, transforms or units changed.

meshes/VLP-16/VLP-16_base_2.dae.change: Replace only literal angle brackets in the id/name node labels <STL_BINARY>; no mesh coordinates, indices, materials, transforms or units changed.

active_input_chain.entry: ../gbplanner/launch/smb/smb_sim.launch:33 loads smb_gazebo/spawn_smb.launch; that loads smb_description/launch/description.launch and smb.urdf.xacro.
active_input_chain.relay: ../gbplanner/launch/smb/smb_sim.launch:42-43 relays both /velodyne_points and /lidar_front_points into /input_pointcloud; line 50 remaps /pointcloud to that shared input.
active_input_chain.server: ../planner_common/src/voxblox/voxblox_common_impl.cpp:18-21 constructs the Voxblox server with the planner node handles. Retained tsdf_server.cc:59 subscribes pointcloud and :338 uses each message header.frame_id/stamp for its TF.
active_input_chain.timing_caveat: ROS1 TsdfServer::insertPointcloud :359 uses one strict timestamp gate for the merged stream. With min_time_between_msgs_sec=0, equal-stamp second-sensor messages can be dropped; configured two-source input is proven, complete per-frame fusion is not. ROS2 separate source queues are an explicit existing adaptation.
active_input_chain.gain: ../gbplanner/config/smb/gbplanner_config.yaml:17-25 and :114 select only VLP16, range20m, 360x30 degree FOV, 5x5 degree angular gain grid, zero source gain extrinsic offset, frontier threshold .05. OS1 contributes mapping but is not a second gain sensor.
active_input_chain.mapping: ../gbplanner/config/smb/voxblox_sim_config.yaml:6 max_ray_length_m=50; min_ray_length_m=.5, voxel size .2. These are mapper integration settings, not physical lidar maximum ranges.

velodyne.collision: Cylinder r=.0516,l=.0717 at velodyne_base_link z=.03585; source mesh visuals and full inertia retained.

lidar_front.original_type: ray (gpu default false at this call site)
lidar_front.fixed_chain: base_link -> sensor_head_base_link (.2,0,.576) -> lidar_front (.1,-.3,-.1,rpy0,.5,0). Gazebo scan attaches to lidar_front; do not add the auxiliary os1_lidar link offset .03618.
lidar_front.collision: Tilted cylinder r=.04,l=.073 at lidar_front z=.0365; original nonzero inertia and Ouster visual retained.

head_physics.preserved: Original fixed mounts, inertial tensors, masses, collision solids and visuals for the head, two lidars and three camera bodies.

conversion.selection: generate_robot_description(...,sensor_profile='upstream',gazebo_share=...) is explicit; default compact keeps the prior single 720x16,5Hz,6m scan.
conversion.method: Official xacro expands temporary copies; source files remain unchanged. Original sensor_head invocation is copied from smb.urdf.xacro. Native lidar scan/FOV/ranges/update_rate are copied from expanded original sensors.
conversion.native_type: Both scans use Fortress gpu_lidar. Original OS1 CPU ray becomes GPU rendering, an explicit simulator adaptation.
conversion.noise_and_range: Native Gaussian range sigma .008 replaces Classic plugin noise. Original GazeboRosLidar.cpp:296-304 first rejects <=min or >=max, then adds noise; :325 applies the strict gate again. Native sensor noise runs before the ROS output gate, so exact noise/RNG and pre-noise gate equivalence are not claimed. VLP native ray max stays131m; ROS output must keep its separate strict130m bound. Invalid/no-return samples must not become fake far obstacles.
conversion.camera_and_imu_scope: Camera bodies remain; native RGB streams default to disabled and are enabled only with cameras:=true alongside sensor_profile:=upstream. The optional conversion preserves the original three monocular camera settings and publishes REP-103 optical frames; Classic camera plugins are not loaded. Explicit upstream also enables the native OS1 IMU and effective Hector noise adaptation.
conversion.names: Original rgb_cam_* joint names collide with their child-link names during SDF reduction. Only those fixed-joint identifiers gain _mount_joint; geometry and poses are unchanged.
conversion.self_visibility: Existing native visibility mask continues to exclude all robot visuals, including head parts, from GPU lidar. Collision solids remain active.
conversion.wheel_slip: Nominal optional WheelSlip loads use the full fixed-joint rotation chain and each local inertial COM. Bilinear front/rear-left/right allocation balances weight and horizontal moments; it is an explicit static normalization, not measured tire/contact load.
conversion.ament_symlink_install: Mesh URI must name a known package, a relative path and no .. component. Resolve only after that validation and require a file; ament-installed individual file symlinks may point into the original source tree outside the installed directory. This preserves the installed package entry while allowing standard symlink-install.

static_verification: results/smb_sensor_profile/model_static1.json; official xacro/ign sdf checks, not a simulation run.

runtime_attempts.reason: The initial helper required resolved mesh targets to remain under the installed package root. ament symlink-install uses individual source-file symlinks, so a valid VLP mesh was rejected during launch model generation.
runtime_attempts.resolution: Validate the URI path lexically (known package, not absolute, no ..), then permit the existing package entry to resolve to its source-file target. No sensor/model/physics parameters changed.
runtime_attempts.rerun: Not performed by this agent; root will run runtime2.

os1_imu.mount: Original fixed chain with pitch .5 rad and os1_imu local offset; see model1.sdf sensor pose.
os1_imu.implementation: Native noise-free IMU with world reference -> bridge -> Hector adapter smb_imu.yaml.
os1_imu.scope: Static and idle observations only; motion response unverified.

rgb_cameras.physical_model: Source bodies, mounting, masses and inertia unchanged
rgb_cameras.frames: REP-103 rgb_cam_*_optical_frame; fixed rpy(-pi/2,0,-pi/2) from physical camera frames
rgb_cameras.camera_info: Native raw Info is retained under /gazebo/rgb_cam_*_camera_info_raw. Adapter sets only P[3]=0 for independent monocular cameras, undoing Fortress automatic same-link stereo grouping. Original Classic hackBaseline=.07 is not retained.
rgb_cameras.runtime: 40frames/camera;20.041Hz source timestamps,6.33-6.36Hz wall clock;100% exact-stamp Image/Info pairing; cleaned up

services.calibrate: std_srvs/Empty: reset only gyro dynamic bias to zero

hector_runtime_interfaces.bias_topic: output_topic + /bias: sensor_msgs/Imu, same header, current dynamic drift + fixed offset for accel/rate, actual orientationError, zero covariance
hector_runtime_interfaces.preserved: No service-generated sample, timestamp reset, RNG draw or changes to drift/noise parameters
hector_runtime_interfaces.finite_request_adaptation: Nonfinite vectors are ignored and counted; original empty response has no success field
hector_runtime_interfaces.remaining: ROS1 dynamic_reconfigure wire protocol/UI is replaced by native ROS2 parameters; original RNG implementation/library bit parity is not claimed.

hector_dynamic_parameters.implementation: Native ROS 2 parameter services on gbplanner_rmf_imu_adapter; os0 and enabled smb_os1 streams
hector_dynamic_parameters.types: accel/rate: three doubles; yaw: one double
hector_dynamic_parameters.startup: Preserves loaded per-axis values and 1/3600 default frequency; cfg GUI defaults do not overwrite source model defaults
hector_dynamic_parameters.native_parameter_adaptation: Only named arrays/scalars change. Unlike ROS1 dynamic_reconfigure, an update does not broadcast all five scalar GUI values over all three axes. ROS1 wire protocol/UI are not emulated.
hector_dynamic_parameters.atomicity: Validate complete Hector-only batch before applying. Reject mixed non-Hector batches; static node parameters are read-only. Pure use_sim_time retains rclcpp behavior.
hector_dynamic_parameters.state: No RNG consumption, drift reset, time reset or synthetic sample on configuration. Offset contributes to total published bias and pseudo-AHRS. SetBias changes dynamic drift only; rate calibration preserves fixed offset.
hector_dynamic_parameters.measurement: native_measurement * scale_error + offset + updated_dynamic_drift + gaussian_noise * N(0,1)
hector_dynamic_parameters.yaw: ScaleError remains unused, matching source yawModel.update(dt); yaw white noise affects covariance but not pseudo-AHRS bias quaternion.
hector_dynamic_parameters.covariance: Acceleration/rate covariance retain startup GaussianNoise squared; orientation covariance follows current GaussianNoise, as in the source plugin.
hector_dynamic_parameters.scope: Each native stream contributes 30 same-stamp raw/output/bias samples after a runtime update, plus paused state transitions. No noise-distribution, motion or complete-migration claim.
